name: JPG Glitch
tagline: Databend a still on this device. Save the glitch. Nothing is uploaded.
description:
Drop a picture, or take one. Four sliders — amount, seed, iterations, quality — smash the JPEG so the photo tears, blooms, and bands. The glitch is the point. Download it when you like what you see.

The last picture and the last slider settings come back the next time you open the app, still only on this device. There is no account, and nothing is sent anywhere.

An unofficial port of jpg-glitch by snorpey.
